title: Each session states plainly what it is doing, including nothing

requirements.text: sessionStatus returns one of five kinds: task under way, unrecorded work, needs you, paused on a task, or nothing going on
An idle reminder from Claude Code leaves state.json of a finished turn unchanged, keeping its last message
A session with no task shows Nothing going on with its last finished task, and labels the goal Project goal

evidence: testASessionSaysWhatItIsDoing passes for all five kinds plus ended

real Lunenburg split.png: left pane Project goal Report data, Nothing going on, Last finished Unlanded tables; right pane Report data 1/3, Paused on Report families with its message
